original.statement: The CEL vocabulary used in the telemetry APIs and extensions was updated; the evidence does not say what changed or what the effect is.

decision.reason: [ev-11bb4ca0844c] says only that the CEL vocabulary used in the telemetry APIs and extensions was updated. The subject name "telemetry-cel-vocabulary" uses the note's own key words, and no other family fits better. behavior-changed is the least committal change type that fits: the same telemetry CEL expressions now use an updated vocabulary. The note does not say whether terms were added, removed or renamed, which is why confidence is low.
